messages.content: I have the Phoenix addresses now. The opening review is at 4040 East Thomas Road, and Wednesday morning is at the district office, 3100 West Ray Road in Chandler. The airport hotel no longer makes sense. Find me something between those two for Monday and Tuesday nights.

I’ll compare two-night stays for January 12-14 along the Tempe corridor, including taxes, rental-car parking, cancellation terms, and realistic drive times to both addresses. Is one room for one guest still correct?
Yes. One room, one guest. I’ll pick up a rental car Monday night after the flight lands at 9:31.

That points to south Tempe rather than the airport itself. I found three practical options: Hilton Garden Inn Tempe ASU Research Park, Homewood Suites by Hilton Phoenix Airport South, and Fairfield Inn & Suites Phoenix Tempe/Airport. I’m checking the complete totals and late-arrival handling now.
Skip anything with a prepaid rate. I need the reimbursable total to be clear, including parking.

The best flexible rates are: Hilton Garden Inn Tempe ASU Research Park at $418.62 including taxes, with free self-parking; Homewood Suites Phoenix Airport South at $446.18 including taxes, with free self-parking; and Fairfield Inn Phoenix Tempe/Airport at $389.74 including taxes, plus $30 total for parking, making the stay $419.74. Each can be paid at the hotel.
What are the cancellation deadlines? And give me the drives for Tuesday morning to the restaurant and Wednesday morning to Chandler.

Hilton Garden Inn can be canceled without penalty through 11:59 p.m. local time on Sunday, January 11. Homewood Suites has the same deadline. Fairfield requires cancellation by 6:00 p.m. local time on Saturday, January 10; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax. Estimated weekday morning drives are 18-25 minutes from Hilton Garden Inn to the restaurant and 12-18 minutes to the Chandler office; 12-18 and 22-30 minutes from Homewood Suites; and 14-20 and 20-28 minutes from Fairfield.
So Homewood is better for Tuesday, but Hilton Garden is better for Wednesday. What about the drive back to PHX after the Chandler meeting?

From the Chandler office, allow about 25-35 minutes to PHX in late afternoon if traffic is ordinary. Hilton Garden Inn is about 14-20 minutes from PHX when leaving the hotel, Homewood Suites about 8-12 minutes, and Fairfield about 10-15 minutes. On Wednesday, the office-to-airport drive matters more because you’ll already have checked out.
Right. I don’t care about being close to the airport Tuesday night if I’m driving from Chandler Wednesday afternoon anyway. Compare the actual rooms and breakfast.

Hilton Garden Inn offers a standard king room with a mini-fridge, microwave, desk, and restaurant breakfast available for purchase; breakfast is not included in the quoted rate. Homewood Suites offers a king studio with a kitchenette and includes hot breakfast. Fairfield offers a standard king with mini-fridge and includes breakfast. All three show late check-in available, but the reservation should note arrival after 10:30 p.m.
Is the Hilton total definitely two nights and not before tax?

Yes. The Hilton Garden Inn breakdown is $179 for Monday, $183 for Tuesday, and $56.62 in combined taxes and fees, totaling $418.62 for two nights. Self-parking is complimentary, so there is no additional mandatory hotel charge for the rental car.
And Homewood? I want the same breakdown.

Homewood Suites is $191 for Monday, $195 for Tuesday, and $60.18 in taxes and fees, for a complete two-night total of $446.18. Self-parking and breakfast are included. No destination or resort fee is listed.

The extra $27.56 isn’t important. Which one creates less total driving across both workdays? Assume I go hotel to restaurant Tuesday morning, restaurant back to hotel Tuesday evening, hotel to Chandler Wednesday morning, then Chandler to PHX.

Hilton Garden Inn is the lower-driving choice overall. Using typical traffic ranges, that sequence is roughly 64-98 minutes of driving from Hilton Garden Inn versus about 71-108 minutes from Homewood Suites. Homewood saves time on both restaurant legs, but Hilton saves more on Wednesday morning to Chandler. The Chandler-to-PHX leg is identical regardless of hotel.
Any concern with the Hilton location or late arrival after picking up the car?

No material concern. It is in a business and residential area near the Loop 101 and Loop 202 connections. From the rental-car center, expect about 15-20 minutes late Monday evening. The front desk operates around the clock, and the flexible rate allows payment at check-in. I would still add the flight arrival and an estimated 10:30-11:00 p.m. arrival note.
Make that the primary. I want one fallback in case it sells out or the rate changes. Which is the cleaner backup?

Homewood Suites is the cleaner fallback. Its cancellation deadline matches Hilton’s, parking is included, the full price is only $27.56 higher, and it has a larger room plus breakfast. Fairfield’s nominal room rate is lower, but parking removes nearly all of the savings and its cancellation deadline is a day earlier.
Do either of the two finalists require a deposit now?

No advance deposit is shown for either flexible rate. Both require a card guarantee, with payment collected by the property. Canceling after the deadline or failing to arrive can trigger a one-night room-and-tax charge.
Don’t book yet. Keep the Hilton as primary and Homewood as fallback until I know whether Wednesday ends at 4:00 or 5:30. Tie that back to the flights so I know what decision is left.

Held for the next decision: primary is Hilton Garden Inn Tempe ASU Research Park, January 12-14, standard king, $418.62 total, free parking, cancelable through 11:59 p.m. January 11. Fallback is Homewood Suites Phoenix Airport South, king studio, $446.18 total, free parking and breakfast, with the same cancellation deadline. If Wednesday ends firmly at 4:00 p.m., carry forward United 2036 at 7:15 p.m.; if it may run until 5:30 p.m., carry forward American 2871 at 9:05 p.m. The outbound remains United 2248 on Monday, ORD 6:35 p.m. to PHX 9:31 p.m. Nothing has been booked; the remaining choice is the Wednesday end time, which determines the return flight and then the final hotel selection.
